GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on well, got warm late # best work late
Jumped Ok eased to last 8 lengths. last turn. ran on very strongly between runners # big win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in at the start and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down last 10 Lengths within 8 Lengths x 600m Saved Ground Made Ground Inside Turning for home , within 4 Lengths @ 400m 2 Lengths @ 300m, then run peaked 200m - # inside inferior
Jumped Ok sat rail 11l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong taking lead late # all honours
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. looking for run turn 3 lengths. forced way out 200 metres. ran on strongly # big win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 300m improved into a position where there was insufficient room to do so between runners, clipped heels and blundered and shifted out and made heavy contact with runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide 2 lengths. joined leaders turn 3 wide. peaked late # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 2 lengths. moved up turn 1 length. just battled in Straight # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well landed box seat 1 length off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off behind leader, off heels took over passing 200m and drew clear, soft across line # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up in the early part of the straight and passing the 350m was eased out to obtain clear running and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 3 lengths. checked 1100 metres. moved up 3 Wide turn 1 length. got to front 200 metres. tired late, 3 Wide trip barrier 3 # not much luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the 1100m lost its rightful running and had to be restrained.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Inside 6th 6 Lengths @ 1000m. similar Straightening Up Just a bit closer. couldn't quicken . winner led from 1000m (vetted - all clear) # no run on/1st led
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced in restricted room passing the 150m. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. looking for run turn. got cutaway in Straight . ran on strongly # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1kg overweight in accordance with the policy.
